messages:
anya: Short thread to finalize the pilot acceptance checklist for the Optimize toolkit (batching/caching/quant recs + eval alerts). Need concrete numbers so eng can sign off.

devon: ok. i'll throw down a compact set of gates we can iterate on.

samir: Keep telemetry separate from safety. Telemetry: latency/cost/traceability. Safety: eval regressions and tenant controls.

lila: +1. also we should include a minimum batch target to avoid tiny-batch anti-patterns. propose min avg batch = 6 for routes where batching is enabled.

anya: Draft gates below — feel free to tweak:

``` 
Pilot acceptance (Optimize toolkit v0.1):
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms for seq_len <512; p95 <= 500ms for seq_len >=512. Measurements on Dedicated pilot hardware under warmed conditions where applicable.
- Batching/Cache: warmed KV-cache hit rate >= 60% for cacheable flows; average batch size >= 6 for batched routes during peak windows.
- Economics: median per-token cost reduction >= 15% for batchable traffic vs current baseline, measured on anonymized pilot traffic replay.
- Quant safety: quantized recommendations must not produce >2% absolute drop on primary eval metric (BLEU/embedding match/LLM-scored pass) on our control suite.
- Eval-trigger alerts: trigger threshold = >7% relative drop over 2k evals or 48h, whichever occurs first. Target alert FP <= 5% and FN <= 12% on labeled regression set.
- Tenant controls: tenants can choose auto-apply, recommend-only, or opt-out. Every applied recommendation requires an audit log entry and per-tenant rollback toggle.
- Rollout/ops: canary rollout at 3% traffic, auto-rollback on sustained SLO breach for >10 minutes, manual approval required for GA roll.
- Fallbacks: if recommended variant incompatible with runtime, auto-fallback to nearest compatible variant and emit a flaggable metric/event.
- Telemetry: pilot retention 21 days, must surface 5 example traces per alert for debugging.
```

lila: That batch size is higher than earlier threads, but it gives better econ signal. I'm fine with it if ops can demonstrate stable queuing.

devon: For econ measurement we should require a seeded replay of 12k anonymized prompts from prod-telemetry. Also require bootstrap comparison over at least 6 hours of pilot traffic.

samir: For eval alerts, add that we need an adjustable detection window and a guardrail that prevents alerting on low-volume noisy routes.

anya: Noted. Finalize owners + deliverables:
- devon: own econ measurement harness + replay (deliver artifact + runbook)
- lila: own batching config + queue safety test evidence
- samir: own eval-alert tuning, labeled regression set, and FN/FP reporting
- ops-bot: scheduled deploy window reminder (pilot cluster Fri 09:00 UTC)

lila: i'll post the queue stability scripts and a short runbook by EOD Wed (1919999900).

devon: replay harness ETA Thu noon (1919999600). will include anonymization steps.

samir: eval set and initial thresholds by Thu EOD. will include a small labeled set for FN analysis.

anya: timeline: if artifacts are in by owners' dates, we aim to start the pilot canary next week. If anyone misses the milestone, ping here and we can re-scope.

ops-bot: Reminder: pilot cluster maintenance window Sat 11:00 UTC.

anya: One more ops request: capture a simple UX flow for tenant controls (recommend-only vs auto) so CS can preflight enterprise opt-ins.

lila: i'll draft the UX snippet and share in the ticket.

anya: Great. I'm pasting this into the roadmap ticket and marking owners. Short thread, clear gates. :white_check_mark:
